message.content: {"drafts":[{"title":"Seeking In-Browser LLM Tools for JSON to Chart.js Config Generation with Small Models","body":"I'm exploring options for running small LLMs entirely in the browser to convert JSON data into valid Chart.js configurations. I've looked briefly at MLC.ai as a potential runtime but haven't tested it myself. Does anyone have experience with lightweight browser inference frameworks that handle structured output like Chart.js configs well? Also, are there particular models or prompting approaches that work reliably for transforming JSON into visualization specs?
